items.title: Overly Restrictive Name Check and Fix Incoming - October 27
items.summary: Overly Restrictive Name Check and Fix Incoming - October 27 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) In WoW Forever, we’ve been working on the restricted name list, which is a list the game uses to check for non-profane names that we wish to restrict, such as major Warcraft lore characters or names that are blocked for technical reasons. Today we’ve determined that we have a bug in the process that caused the game to be overly restrictive with some names. For example, it has been incorrectly restricting names containing “c-o-n”. With the next realm restarts in each region, we’re going to implement the fix. Afterward, if you previously received a message that said “That name is restricted” for a name that you think should have been allowed, please feel free to try again. Thank you!

items.title: Gold Transactions Must Be Direct
items.summary: Gold Transactions Must Be Direct Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) We’ve recently completed a round of actions taken against accounts that were found to have participated in spending real money on gold provided by a third party (RMT). Some of the accounts actioned purchased the illicit gold and had the seller deliver it to a different player who provided a service to the purchaser, such as a raid carry. Please be reminded that gold received from an intermediate player has an extremely high likelihood of being illicit gold that was part of an RMT. To avoid actions such as account suspension and the removal of illicit gold, players should always directly transfer gold from the player buying the carry (or other activity) to the player providing the carry. Guilds that provide carries to players, who pay for them with gold that comes from an intermediate, are at risk of seeing that gold removed by Blizzard. Thank you very much!

items.title: WoW: Forever Beta Development Notes - Racial Abilities and Traits Tuning
items.summary: WoW: Forever Beta Development Notes - Racial Abilities and Traits Tuning Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) As we approach the launch of WoW Forever, we’ve been reflecting on feedback we’ve heard on racial abilities and passive traits: Some players have expressed that some of the new racial traits feel too generic, while others have expressed concerns that some are objectively stronger than others. In taking a final pass on these, we’ve prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles. In some places where we had replaced role- or class-focused racials with generic ones, we’re rolling those changes back. One exception to this is the weapon specialization racials, like humans’ Sword Specialization or orcs’ Axe Specialization. While those have a strong fantasy component to them, it is not healthy in the long run for future raid and dungeon loot tables to be evaluated through the lens of “required” weapon types. At the same time, we’re doing a tuning pass on some of the remaining passive bonuses to help ensure that they aren’t skewing outcomes in a way that limits player preferences. items.title: Class Tuning Incoming - October 27
items.summary: Class Tuning Incoming - October 27 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The following class adjustments will arrive with scheduled weekly maintenance (October 27 in this region). Class Changes Druid Feral All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat. Restoration Developer’s note: These changes are intended to help Restoration Druid deal with burst damage in dungeons, as they are behind other healers. They are performing well in raid settings, so we are targeting talents and abilities that are favored when healing a 5-person group. Verdancy healing increased by 60%. Does not affect PvP combat. Regrowth healing increased by 10%. Does not affect PvP combat. Improved Swiftmend increases Swiftmend healing by 40% (was 30%). Does not affect PvP combat. Hunter Marksmanship Developers’ notes: These changes are intended to boost the area damage effectiveness of Marksmanship Hunters. Trick Shots now increases the ricochet damage of Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire by 85% (was 75%). Explosive Shot damage increased by 10%. Volley damage increased by 10%. Mage Fire All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat. Rogue Subtlety Developers’ notes: The buff Subtlety received as compensation alongside changes in the 12.1.5 patch overshot expectations, so we’re rolling back a significant portion of that buff.
